prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game albedo texture, square and seamlessly tileable on all four edges, for the ancient hollow stump landmark in our insect RTS Under the Canopy. Flat orthographic surface only, no object, no environment, no perspective. Warm dark walnut and umber bark with tall vertically running irregular fibrous ridges and deeply split long furrows. Broad sculptural bark flakes and splintered grain, occasional narrow pale exposed heartwood, restrained secondary detail. Hand-painted stylized 3D game texture with a tactile chunky shape language that remains readable from the RTS camera. Predominantly medium-dark rich brown, absolutely no gray stone paving pattern. No lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion baked around an object, no moss or leaves, no text or border. Ridges should flow vertically with uneven heights and thicknesses; broad forms, not a uniform set of straight planks. The texture will wrap a giant ancient stump and arched fallen trunks.
processing: Sharp resize to 1024x1024 PNG; original retained.
limitations: Seamless tiling requested; exact pixel edge matching is not yet verified.
